issues.issue: first_cycle_approval.value=true but the review explicitly states the Division Director recommended a Complete Response in the October 16, 2008 review, which the instructions say contradicts value=true.

The n text labels doses as '100 mg/d N=224, 200 mg/d N=441', but the citation only gives raw numbers 'N=223 N=224 N=441' with no support that N=441 corresponds to 200 mg/d (likely a combined/pooled column), so the dose-to-N mapping is uncited and the odd 441 vs 223/224 pattern is suspicious.

Result reports the 200 mg/d column as '118 (27%)' responders against placebo 43 (19%), but the citation's first column (61 (27%)) corresponds to the 100 mg/d arm which is omitted; the result cherry-picks columns and mislabels which dose arm is being reported.

Result states 'The six-month results for the 200-mg per day FM pain endpoint were not statistically significant' yet the trial's primary endpoint failing at 6 months is not reflected in an internal consistency note; the trial is presented as supportive without flagging that the 6-month primary endpoint was missed.

For Study 2 the 200 mg/d FM Syndrome responders are reported as '55 (14%)' which is LOWER than the 100 mg/d arm's '58 (15%)', an inverse dose-response that is reproduced from the quote but presented without note; verify the quote actually maps 55 (14%) to the 200 mg/d column rather than a stitched mismatch.
uncited_numbers flags '100' and '200' in the n field, but these are dose labels (mg/d) and should be dismissed as a false positive.

uncited_numbers flags '1' and '6' (Study 1 label and 6-month duration); the '6'-month duration is supported by the design citation ('Study 031 was a six-month trial'), so dismiss as false positive, though the label 'Study 1' differs from the source's 'Study 031'.
uncited_numbers flags '2'; the '3-month' duration is supported by the design citation, so dismiss as false positive, though 'Study 2' differs from source's 'Study 02'.
uncited_numbers flags '3', '100', '200' in the result field; these are the 3-month landmark and dose labels, dismiss as false positives.
uncited_numbers flags '22', '256', '2009'; these are the NDA number and approval year (excluded categories/already-known identifiers), dismiss as false positives.

uncited_numbers flags '2014' (final report due date) which is a date and the due date is not in the citation quote; low severity as it is a date, but note the 'final report due October 2014' detail has no citation support.
uncited_numbers flags '505' and '3' (the 505(o)(3) statutory citation); the '(required under 505(o)(3))' parenthetical is not in the citation quote and is an added, uncited characterization.
uncited_numbers flags '505' and '3' (505(o)(3)); the statutory basis parenthetical is not supported by the citation quote.

priority_review is set to false with no citation; the review does not establish whether this was standard or priority review, so the false value is an unverified assertion (possible completeness gap for an approval_program designation the drug may have).
